AEK-999.description:
A modernized version of the PKM developed during the 90s with the goal to improve its capabilities as a LMG/SAW role.
The AEK-999 was capable of sustained fire without requiring a quick-change barrel and is remarkably accurate with hipfiring or when held by the bipod. It however lost in military trials to the PKP Pecheneg.
Average fire rate with above-average hipfire control and comes with a suppressor equipped at all times.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
AEK-999.name: AEK-999

ChainSAW.description: An unconventional ergonomic conversion kit for the Stoner 96, designed to be fired from the hip and held like a chainsaw. While various methods were tested to aid the user's accuracy, none made the ChainSAW's accuracy consistent enough to push it past the prototype stage. Possesses decent damage with good mobility and an incredibly high belt-fed magazine capacity, giving the gun extremely consistent damage output - even if it's not the most accurate.
ChainSAW.name: ChainSAW

COLT LMG.description: A Dakarheim-designated squad automatic weapon based on the AR-15 platform with a heavy barrel, large heat shroud, and 60-round magazine. A jack-of-all-trades with a somewhat slow reload.
COLT LMG.name: COLT LMG

MG36.description: A heavy-barrel variant of the Eisenmark STG-91 rifle, using 100-round beta c-mags. Low damage, but has a high fire rate and low recoil.
MG36.name: MG36

FALO 50.41.description:
An early Cold War Belvaunian LMG based off of the FAL, possessing a heavy barrel and shorter handguard for improved cooling.

The gun was replaced in service with the more capable FN MAG due to various reliability and controllability issues present with the FALO.

Possesses a below-average magazine capacity and somewhat mediocre handling, but very high damage.

Model submitted by Rialag!
FALO 50.41.name: FALO 50.41

PKM.description:
A heavy Zarovian belt-fed machine gun designed in the 60s, a modernized, product-improved version of the PK.
Uses the powerful 7.62x54mmR cartridge designed to rip through enemies with a relatively low fire rate and average recoil control.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
PKM.name: PKM

AUG HBAR.description:
A heavy-barrel, open-bolt variant of the UAR, with a slightly slower fire rate and larger magazine. Accurate, but with a slow reload.

Model submitted by Rialag.
AUG HBAR.name: AUG HBAR

REAPR.description:
A .338 Lapua Magnum 'lightweight' machine gun concept, designed to be lighter and more portable than traditional MMGs without sacrificing any stopping power. The entire rifle can be taken apart and stored in a standard sized backpack.

Possesses extremely high damage potential, but has a somewhat low rate of fire and only 20 rounds per belt.

Model submitted by MMX.
REAPR.name: REAPR

QJB-95 LSW.description:
The QJB-95 LSW, formerly known as the QBB-95, is an LMG variant of the QBZ-95 characterized by the longer, heavier barrel and the addition of a bipod.

The gun also uses a heavier 5.8x42mm round with improved ballistics and penetration compared to the standard ones used in the QBZ-95.

Community submitted model.
QJB-95 LSW.name: QJB-95 LSW

RPK-16.description:
A Zarovian LMG derived from the RPK-400, replacing the RPK and RPK-74 in service. It fires 5.45x39mm ammo out of a 95-round drum magazine, but can also use older RPK-74 magazines.

Very high sustain with relatively moderate damage and somewhat high recoil. Minor risk of betrayal.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X
RPK-16.name: RPK-16
